text: THE PRIME MINISTER'S QUOTE MATCHES THE DESIGN IT WAS DRAWN FROM. The card stood on a pale-blue band, which put a third ground between the hero photograph and the card and read as a seam rather than a section; the Figma frame's gradient is switched off in the file, so the card now sits on the page's own white with 32 above and below, as drawn. It gains the 1px peach hairline the design gives it — bound to the nearest published secondary rung, because the drawn #FFC1BC is off the ramp and no border/brand/secondary rung exists. The quotation mark was a 64px Material `format_quote` at full strength, which is a CLOSING mark standing above the words; it is now the opening mark the design draws, at 128 behind the first line at 40%, drawn as a vector because the icon scale tops out at 64. The quote column takes the design's deeper top padding and its 24 above the attribution rule. On a phone the mark scales to keep the design's mark-to-type ratio, and the portrait caps at 240 — at 320 it stood 340px tall and outweighed the quotation it belongs to.
